scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Cucumber Salad: cucumber, onion, white vinegar, white sugar, water, dill.
Step 1 of Cucumber Salad: Gather the ingredients..
Step 2 of Cucumber Salad: Toss sliced cucumbers and onion together in a large bowl. Set aside..

Step 3 of Cucumber Salad: Combine vinegar, sugar, and water in a saucepan over medium-high heat; bring to a boil; pour over cucumbers and onions in the bowl. Stir in dill. Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving..
